title: docs: recover unmatched PM plan artifacts
body:
## Summary

- Recover 175 internal PM plan artifacts plus the Gas City local-only beads guidance from the preserved PM recovery branch.
- Recover the bbolt operator guide and navigation as a separate commit so reviewers can drop or defer that public-doc slice independently.
- Preserve the approved 178-path net delta on a fresh branch based directly on `origin/main`: 176 added, 2 modified, 0 deleted.

## Provenance

- Recovery source retained at `recovered-pm-20260817-1337` (`dd6f4dd7aec9`).
- Before cleanup, all 178 staged blobs matched the preserved recovery branch.
- Cleanup was limited to inherited trailing whitespace in 18 plan files and current public-doc terminology.

## Review risk / hold

The public bbolt guide describes implementation that is not present on current `origin/main`; commit `c52f08ecbe` should be dropped or deferred unless the corresponding implementation is restored. The contributor-plan recovery is isolated in `18a2fb52e3`.

Per the mayor ruling recorded on `ga-bccsbs`, keep this PR held until security alerts 313–316 are cleared.

## Verification

- `git diff --check`
- `make check-docs`
- Full pre-push fast gate passed with `LOCAL_TEST_JOBS=1` after the parallel form twice hit a live herdr pane-allocation race; no tests were skipped.
